remarks: Move right into this beautifully updated two-family duplex. The first floor features a bright three-season enclosed sun porch with a cedar closet, a spacious living room that opens to the kitchen with brand-new cabinets and new stainless steel appliances, plus access to a small deck and side yard. Upstairs, the sunny second floor offers an office/den area, two bedrooms, a full bath, and convenient in-unit laundry. Perfectly located within walking distance to the beach, parks, restaurants, and the train, with easy access to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. Immaculate condition. Street parking available.
